_comment: Transitional, hand-transcribed per-layer states for the Progress page, used only while EpsilonEridaniProgress writes no epsiloneridani-coverage:v1 marker. Keys are roadmap paths (EpsilonEridaniRoadmaps/<Area>, EpsilonEridaniRoadmaps/<Umbrella>/<Sub>, Completed/<Area>). Each entry was read from the roadmap's STATUS.md prose and is bound to exactly what it was read from: to_sha is the library commit the report describes (prefix of at least 7 characters), report_sha a prefix (at least 12) of the SHA-256 of the STATUS.md text, and readme_sha a prefix (at least 12) of the SHA-256 of the README.md the layers were taken from; a change to any of them retires the entry and the layers show as unassessed until re-read. layers maps the README's layer ids to d (reported done), p (reported partial), u (reported untouched) or ? (the report does not say). Sub-roadmaps of an umbrella roadmap are bound to the umbrella's report. notes may explain an individual reading.
